title: Sordland/Turn05/Personal_ReturnOfInvestment
description: Gus calls to tell you the result of the investment.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I was doing well until you gave me..."
entries.dialogueText: “I was doing well until you gave me a call.”
entries.menuText: “I was doing well until you gave me a call.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was sipping my first cup of coffe..."
entries.dialogueText: I was sipping my first cup of coffee for the day when the phone lit up and rang.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I picked up the phone."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the phone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I swore under my breath. I thought..."
entries.dialogueText: I swore under my breath. I thought my schedule was clear for at least half an hour.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It definitely was.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It definitely was.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Mr. President. How are you doing o..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. How are you doing on this fine day, if I may ask?”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Sorry, I know it's underwhelming...."
entries.dialogueText: “Sorry, I know it's underwhelming. I bet you wish you'd gone for a bigger buy-in earlier.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm fine. You?”"
entries.dialogueText: "I'm fine. You?”
entries.menuText: "I'm fine. You?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What is it, Gus?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What is it, Gus?”
entries.menuText: “What is it, Gus?”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I am calling you because I just he..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am calling you because I just heard from the CEO of Armadine Industries, Arron Bridges, regarding the recent initial public offering on the Ventrie City Stock Exchange.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Business as usual on my end. Thank..."
entries.dialogueText: “Business as usual on my end. Thanks for asking."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Oh, come on. You are the president..."
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, come on. You are the president! Nobody got to that seat without taking massive risks.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Well. I will take that. Thank you...."
entries.dialogueText: “Well. I will take that. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“As you might've guessed, it's abou..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you might've guessed, it's about our massive venture investment of 3000 shares worth nearly three million ren.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Thanks to the ongoing trade war, I..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks to the ongoing trade war, I was told that the Armadine stock prices plunged after the IPO. The markets are very volatile right now.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“You will love it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You will love it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm not much of a risk taker.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not much of a risk taker.”
entries.menuText: “I'm not much of a risk taker.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Don't worry. Our stocks are still..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't worry. Our stocks are still secure and they advised us not to sell because a recovery is expected in the near future.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“However, this means that we have n..."
entries.dialogueText: “However, this means that we have not made any profits, and on the contrary have lost fifty percent of the value compared to our initial purchase.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It is. Trust me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It is. Trust me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Darn it. Yes, I do.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Darn it. Yes, I do.”
entries.menuText: “Darn it. Yes, I do.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I'm sorry, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sorry, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It was a good start for sure.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It was a good start for sure.”
entries.menuText: “It was a good start for sure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I knew I shouldn't have listened t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I knew I shouldn't have listened to your advice.”
entries.menuText: “I knew I shouldn't have listened to your advice.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why are you apologizing? It's not..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why are you apologizing? It's not your fault.”
entries.menuText: “Why are you apologizing? It's not your fault.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You know what they say. Don't inve..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know what they say. Don't invest what you can't afford to lose.”
entries.menuText: “You know what they say. Don't invest what you can't afford to lose.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It was risky, yes. But look at whe..."
entries.dialogueText: “It was risky, yes. But look at where we are now!”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Isn't that great?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Isn't that great?”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“At the time, I thought Armadine wa..."
entries.dialogueText: “At the time, I thought Armadine was a sure bet. This trade war came out of nowhere."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Thank you for understanding the un..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for understanding the unfortunate situation.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Great news! So, how much did we ga..."
entries.dialogueText: “Great news! So, how much did we gain?”
entries.menuText: “Great news! So, how much did we gain?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes. It's great. Go on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. It's great. Go on.”
entries.menuText: “Yes. It's great. Go on.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Wasn't Konrath Koronti the one tha..."
entries.dialogueText: “Wasn't Konrath Koronti the one that said that? He was a visionary for the free world for sure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This better be worth it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This better be worth it.”
entries.menuText: “This better be worth it.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Regardless, we still have a hold o..."
entries.dialogueText: “Regardless, we still have a hold on our stocks.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The shares have doubled in price a..."
entries.dialogueText: “The shares have doubled in price at the IPO in the VCSE and we will soon receive the profits made from the investment.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Exactly. Electronics manufacturing..."
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly. Electronics manufacturing has a great future and Armadine seems to have a head start.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I am confident once the effects of..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am confident once the effects of this nasty trade war subside, we'll recover the value of our shares and then some."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I am very pleased to say that we h..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am very pleased to say that we have made gains!”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“That's all I wanted to talk to you..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's all I wanted to talk to you about, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Goodbye for now.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye for now.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Remind me never to do business wit..."
entries.dialogueText: “Remind me never to do business with you ever again.”
entries.menuText: “Remind me never to do business with you ever again.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Keep me up to date on other opport..."
entries.dialogueText: “Keep me up to date on other opportunities.”
entries.menuText: “Keep me up to date on other opportunities.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I knew it was the right call to tr..."
entries.dialogueText: “I knew it was the right call to trust you on this.”
entries.menuText: “I knew it was the right call to trust you on this.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Again, I am so sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: “Again, I am so sorry."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I'll let you know immediately when..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'll let you know immediately when new opportunities arise.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very well. Talk to you later then...."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. Talk to you later then.”
entries.menuText: “Very well. Talk to you later then.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's all thanks to you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's all thanks to you.”
entries.menuText: “It's all thanks to you.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I assure you, this will pale in co..."
entries.dialogueText: “I assure you, this will pale in comparison to what we will do together in the future.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Some things are just worth taking..."
entries.dialogueText: “Some things are just worth taking the risk for.”
entries.menuText: “Some things are just worth taking the risk for.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The line dropped."
entries.dialogueText: The line dropped.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I have a good eye for investments...."
entries.dialogueText: “I have a good eye for investments.”
entries.menuText: “I have a good eye for investments.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Instead of suffering losses due to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Instead of suffering losses due to market volatility like most public firms in Merkopa, we actually came out unscathed. Arcasia wasn't influenced by the Black Tuesday crash!”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It could have been much worse, but..."
entries.dialogueText: “It could have been much worse, but we got out of it with the best outcome. Isn't that great?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Great news! So, how much did we ga..."
entries.dialogueText: “Great news! So, how much did we gain?”
entries.menuText: “Great news! So, how much did we gain?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Unbelievable. How can you say that..."
entries.dialogueText: “Unbelievable. How can you say that when the Sordish economy is crippled?”
entries.menuText: “Unbelievable. How can you say that when the Sordish economy is crippled?”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I think so too.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I think so too.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“You are right, Mr. President. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: “You are right, Mr. President. I'm sorry.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is the beginning of a good pa..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is the beginning of a good partnership. Keep it up.”
entries.menuText: “This is the beginning of a good partnership. Keep it up.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“You're going to want to sit down.""
entries.dialogueText: “You're going to want to sit down."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“That, you do. Did you read Konrath..."
entries.dialogueText: “That, you do. Did you read Konrath Koronti's book on entrepreneurship, by any chance? Everything I know about the market, I learned from him.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“In total we have made...”"
entries.dialogueText: “In total we have made...”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It's not great on our end, either...."
entries.dialogueText: “It's not great on our end, either. Some of our investments are suffering due to Black Tuesday.”

entries.title: Player: "“So you're telling me I spent a for..."
entries.dialogueText: “So you're telling me I spent a fortune on this investment and got nothing back?!”
entries.menuText: “So you're telling me I spent a fortune on this investment and got nothing back?!”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Fair point. I would have felt wors..."
entries.dialogueText: “Fair point. I would have felt worse if your investment was larger.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“At least we didn't invest much and..."
entries.dialogueText: “At least we didn't invest much and have no direct losses.”
entries.menuText: “At least we didn't invest much and have no direct losses.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I know it's not great. But no one..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know it's not great. But no one saw the trade war coming.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“As you might've guessed, it's abou..."
entries.dialogueText: “As you might've guessed, it's about our significant venture investment of 2000 shares worth nearly two million ren.”

entries.dialogueText: “As you might've guessed, it's about our little venture investment of 1000 shares worth nearly a million ren.”

entries.dialogueText: “Let's hope so. I want to trust you Gus.”
entries.menuText: “Let's hope so. I want to trust you Gus.”

entries.dialogueText: “I doubt it. Sell all of our stocks and cut our losses."
entries.menuText: “I doubt it. Sell all of our stocks and cut our losses." [+1 Personal Wealth]

entries.dialogueText: “Very well, sir. I will arrange it and make the transfer to your personal bank account.”

entries.dialogueText: “The shares have doubled in price at the IPO in the VCSE and we will soon receive the profits made from the investment.”

entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Appreciate it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Appreciate it.”

entries.dialogueText: “...nearly two million Sordish Ren!”

entries.dialogueText: “...nearly four million Sordish Ren!”

entries.dialogueText: “...nearly three million Sordish Ren!”

entries.dialogueText: “The money will be transferred to your personal bank account shortly.”

entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. How are you?”

entries.dialogueText: “Not so great. You must have seen what is going on.”

entries.title: Player: "“Eh. You?”"

entries.title: Gus Manger: "“You bet I have.""
entries.dialogueText: “You bet I have."

entries.dialogueText: “Oh, I almost forgot.”

entries.title: Gus Manger: "“The management sent you one of the..."
entries.dialogueText: “The management sent you one of their brand new radios as a gift. Ms. Suno will bring it to you."

entries.dialogueText: He didn't laugh.

entries.speaker: Narrator
